title: Hancock Whitney Celebrates Opening of New Financial Center in McKinney
summary: Hancock Whitney has officially opened a new financial center in McKinney, as the bank continues to expand its regional presence.
body_markdown:
### *Bank expands banking center footprint to eight locations in North Texas*


**


**DALLAS -October 20, 2026 --** Hancock Whitney has officially opened its fourth financial center in North Texas this year, with the latest location in McKinney, as the bank continues to expand its regional presence. The new center at


9110 Virginia Parkway


joins existing locations in Dallas, Plano, Little Elm, Rockwall, Greenville, and Mesquite. Hancock Whitney is also constructing another financial center in Plano.


The McKinney financial center offers a full suite of banking services designed to meet the needs of individuals, families, and businesses. Clients will have access to personal and business banking solutions, wealth management, and lending services, all delivered with Hancock Whitney’s hallmark commitment to exceptional service.


“Our new McKinney location strengthens Hancock Whitney’s commitment to one of the fastest-growing areas in North Texas and allows us to better meet banking needs across the region,” said Will Pyle, Dallas Market President. “With convenient access to neighboring communities including Allen, Fairview, Lowry Crossing, New Hope, and Melissa, this office expands our ability to deliver personalized financial guidance and long-term banking relationships. We are proud to invest in a community that continues to thrive and look forward to helping support its ongoing growth and success.”


The McKinney team brings extensive experience and personalized service to clients in the North Texas area. Led by Pyle, the team includes Sherhonda Dotson, Retail Sales Leader; Johnathan Harris, Financial Center Leader; Jael Mulenga, Financial Center Supervisor; Brycen Kennedy, Universal Banker; and Madelyn Jones, Universal Banker.


Together, they provide comprehensive financial solutions tailored to individual and business needs. The grand opening celebration included a ribbon-cutting ceremony with local business leaders and community partners, underscoring Hancock Whitney’s commitment to fostering strong connections in the region.


**About Hancock Whitney**


Since the late 1800s, Hancock Whitney has embodied core values of Honor & Integrity, Strength & Stability, Commitment to Service, Teamwork, and Personal Responsibility. Hancock Whitney offices and financial centers in Mississippi, Alabama, Florida, Louisiana and Texas offer comprehensive financial products and services, including traditional and online banking; commercial and small business banking; private banking; trust and investment services; healthcare banking; and mortgage services. The company also operates combined loan and deposit production offices in the greater metropolitan areas of Nashville, Tennessee, and Atlanta, Georgia. More information is available at


[www.hancockwhitney.com](https://www.hancockwhitney.com/) .
